scenarios.prerequisites: Organization has usage control enabled and no provider approval rule exists
scenarios.expectedResult:
Can save the provider rule
Rule is listed as approved on the approval policy page
scenarios.notes: Synthetic scenario derived from provisional CUJ: Admin configures allowed registry artifacts.

scenarios.description: Run a workspace using an unapproved provider
scenarios.prerequisites:
T-301
Workspace configuration references a provider that is not approved
scenarios.expectedResult:
Run fails before apply
Error message identifies the unapproved provider
scenarios.notes: Synthetic scenario derived from provisional CUJ: Workspace run fails when an unapproved artifact is used.

scenarios.description: Using Terraform CLI to create a blocked run
scenarios.prerequisites:
T-301
Local Terraform CLI is configured against the Workspace Under Test
scenarios.expectedResult:
Terraform CLI run returns an approval policy error
Run is recorded as failed in the workspace run list
scenarios.notes: Synthetic CLI coverage for workspace operator path.

scenarios.description: Update an approved module rule after a failed run
scenarios.prerequisites:
T-302
A failed run exists for an unapproved module
scenarios.expectedResult:
Can add the module to approved artifacts
Re-running the workspace completes without approval policy error
scenarios.notes: Synthetic scenario derived from provisional CUJ: Admin reviews and updates approval rules.

scenarios.description: Check if approval decision is visible on the run details page
scenarios.expectedResult:
Run details show blocked artifact name
Admin can identify which approval rule is missing
scenarios.notes: Synthetic audience influenced expected result: admin must be able to diagnose missing approval.
